name: quick_capture_live_v1
description: Live-device Quick Capture benchmark. Setup uses the existing Agent shell to trigger the local HTTP endpoint and waits until recall results contain one or more newly persisted screen records. Task prompts deliberately use ordinary user language; the runner scores the resulting recall trace and answer grounding.

tasks.description_for_judge: The setup must have performed a real local Quick Capture before the task. The agent should retrieve the newly persisted screen content and summarize concrete details from the returned evidence without inventing values.

setup.prompt:
这是 benchmark 的设备准备步骤。请只用 shell 直接执行下面的 bash 脚本，不要改写脚本，不要使用 python/python3/jq/wget，也不要调用 save_memory。脚本会先记录当前 memory id 数量，再触发一次 POST /api/quick-capture，并每 2 秒轮询直到出现新增 memory id，最多等待 90 秒。任何命令失败或数量没有增加都必须输出 FAILED: 原因；检测到新增后只输出 READY。

API=http://127.0.0.1:8080
RECALL_BODY='{"input":{"tags":[],"entities":[],"types":["screen_snapshot"],"limit":100}}'
count_memories() {
  response=$(curl -fsS --max-time 20 -X POST "$API/api/tools/recall_memory" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "$RECALL_BODY") || return 1
  printf '%s' "$response" | grep -o 'mem_[0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*' | wc -l | tr -d ' '
}
before=$(count_memories) || { echo 'FAILED: baseline recall'; exit 1; }
capture=$(curl -fsS --max-time 20 -X POST "$API/api/quick-capture") || { echo 'FAILED: quick-capture request'; exit 1; }
case "$capture" in *'"ok":true'*|*'"status":"started"'*) ;; *) echo 'FAILED: quick-capture was not accepted'; exit 1 ;; esac
for i in $(seq 1 45); do
  sleep 2
  after=$(count_memories) || { echo "FAILED: recall poll $i"; exit 1; }
  if [ "$after" -gt "$before" ]; then echo READY; exit 0; fi
done
echo "FAILED: no new memory after 90 seconds (before=$before after=$after)"
exit 1

tasks.prompt: 刚才那页帮我概括一下，挑几个以后还用得上的具体信息说说。没有把握的不要猜。

rubric.check: The trace contains a recall_memory call that returns at least one screen_snapshot with non-empty content.
The final answer contains concrete details that are supported by the content returned from recall_memory, rather than generic statements or invented values.
When the returned screen content is incomplete or ambiguous, the answer distinguishes observed details from uncertainty instead of filling gaps with guesses.

tasks.description_for_judge: The setup performs two sequential real HTTP captures and waits for the persisted count to increase after each. The agent should retrieve both latest records and explain whether the two saves remain distinguishable, without being told the storage type or query tool.

setup.prompt:
这是 benchmark 的设备准备步骤。请只用 shell 直接执行下面的 bash 脚本，不要改写脚本，不要使用 python/python3/jq/wget，也不要调用 save_memory。脚本会连续执行两轮：每轮先记录当前 memory id 数量，触发一次 POST /api/quick-capture，再每 2 秒轮询直到出现新增 memory id，最多等待 90 秒；第二轮必须在第一轮检测到新增后开始。任何命令失败或任一轮没有新增都必须输出 FAILED: 原因；两轮都检测到新增后只输出 READY。

API=http://127.0.0.1:8080
RECALL_BODY='{"input":{"tags":[],"entities":[],"types":["screen_snapshot"],"limit":100}}'
count_memories() {
  response=$(curl -fsS --max-time 20 -X POST "$API/api/tools/recall_memory" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "$RECALL_BODY") || return 1
  printf '%s' "$response" | grep -o 'mem_[0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*' | wc -l | tr -d ' '
}
for round in 1 2; do
  before=$(count_memories) || { echo "FAILED: baseline recall round $round"; exit 1; }
  capture=$(curl -fsS --max-time 20 -X POST "$API/api/quick-capture") || { echo "FAILED: quick-capture request round $round"; exit 1; }
  case "$capture" in *'"ok":true'*|*'"status":"started"'*) ;; *) echo "FAILED: quick-capture was not accepted round $round"; exit 1 ;; esac
  found=0
  for i in $(seq 1 45); do
    sleep 2
    after=$(count_memories) || { echo "FAILED: recall poll round $round"; exit 1; }
    if [ "$after" -gt "$before" ]; then found=1; break; fi
  done
  if [ "$found" -ne 1 ]; then echo "FAILED: no new memory in round $round (before=$before after=$after)"; exit 1; fi
done
echo READY

tasks.prompt: 我刚才连续点了两下保存。两次记录还分得出来吗？把你能确认的内容和两次之间的差别说一下。

rubric.check: The trace contains recall_memory results with at least two screen_snapshot records from the live setup, or clearly shows two distinct newly persisted records.
The final answer does not claim that one deliberate save automatically replaced or deleted the other.
Any claimed difference between the two captures is grounded in the returned memory content; if they are identical, the answer says so instead of inventing a difference.
